customTierLists.name: Batalla de Alianza
customTierLists.author: Shiruishi
customTierLists.description:
ABX/ABL/ABI modes only.
If your account is strong enough, putting a 2nd dealer instead of a support could improve your score.
Overall, Competition > Rage in ABL and Rage > Competition in ABI; in ABX, there's not much difference.
Best striker for ABX is Loki (try to hit with as many mods as possible); for ABL is Miles (2nd option: Ghost Rider); for ABI, use a striker that matches the main dealer's instinct.

customTierLists.name: Arena de Equipos
customTierLists.author: Shiruishi
customTierLists.description: Team Battle Arena PvP mode only. You can use "Rigged Leader" in the middle position to attract opponent's leader (usually Native-T3 powerhouses) and let your dealers in the side position deal damage.

customTierLists.name: Ideal CTP List
customTierLists.author: CrisisCardio
customTierLists.description:
A list of the most Ideal CTP for each character (at least to my own current knowledge).

PVE characters can sometimes use weaker CTP's if need be, but PVP almost always require their most ideal CTP to be effective.

For Insight and Liberation, try to equip them in a way where each pair of supports have one of each for maximum effectiveness (Example: Insight Dazzler and Lib Cyclops).
